name: Dreamscape Memory
description: A recurring scavenger hunt mini game. It started in the 3rd Anniversary event.

phases.name: How to play
phases.description: Use Dream Fishbits to start a chapter, then start each section. Find all the items listed at the bottom, in groups of three, to finish a section. If you run out of time, spend Dreambells for extra time and 1 hint, and each later use in a section costs more. Hints do not carry to the next chapter. Finish all sections to claim the chapter rewards.

phases.name: Failing a section
phases.description: Failing resets your progress and kicks you out of the chapter, and you get some Dream Fishbits back: chapter 1 gives back 10, chapter 2 gives 16, chapter 3 gives 18, chapter 4 gives 16, chapter 5 gives 10, and chapters 6 to 10 give none.

phases.name: Rewards
phases.description: Daily Missions (log in, find items, and make 1 purchase), Chapter Rewards after each chapter, and Recall Road. Each section gives Recall XP that you claim when you finish a chapter and that fills the Recall Road.

rewards.name: Dream Odyssey
rewards.note: Avatar frame skin in Recall Road

rewards.name: Dream Nest
rewards.note: Event island building in Recall Road. It cannot be upgraded with island Mythic general shards, only with pieces from this event. It has levels 1, 6, and 10.

rewards.name: Dream Fishbit
rewards.note: Unused ones do not carry to the next event. The tins stay in your backpack.

tips: If you have a farm account, play there first to study the maps.
Maps are random. The order of chapters 2 to 10 differs between players, but items stay in the same place within a chapter.
Tapping the wrong spot costs no time. The game shows an item if you take too long, but in later levels the delay is not worth it.
Later chapters have more sections and less time for each.
The hint button is the magnifying glass above the third item.
